appName.description: Extension name. A brand name, keep it as is in every language.

appDescription.message: Mirror any DOM interactions from a source tab to a target tab in real time.
appDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser and the store. Keep it under 132 characters.

appTagline.description: Short tagline under the name in the popup header.

logoAlt.description: Alternative text of the logo image.

settingsOpenLabel.description: Accessible label of the gear button that opens the settings panel.

settingsCloseLabel.description: Accessible label of the button that closes the settings panel.

infoOpenLabel.description: Accessible label and tooltip of the info button.

infoCloseLabel.description: Accessible label of the button that closes the info panel.

statusIdle.description: Session status pill: no session running.

statusActive.description: Session status pill: a session is running.

statusPaused.description: Session status pill: the session is paused.

statusError.description: Session status pill: the last action failed.

sourceUrlLabel.description: Label of the field for the tab whose interactions are captured.

urlPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of URL fields. Keep as is.

sourceUrlHint.description: Hint under the source URL field.

targetUrlLabel.description: Label of the field for a tab that receives the mirrored interactions.

targetUrlHint.description: Hint under a target URL field.

addTarget.description: Button that adds another target URL field. Keep the leading plus sign.

startSession.description: Main button that opens the tabs and starts mirroring.

removeTarget.description: Tooltip of the button that removes a target URL field before the session starts.

removeActiveTarget.description: Tooltip of the button that drops one target from a running session.

errorUrlRequired.description: Validation error under an empty URL field.

errorUrlInvalid.description: Validation error for text that is not a URL.

errorUrlScheme.message: Only http:// and https:// are allowed.
errorUrlScheme.description: Validation error for other URL schemes.

errorUrlDomain.description: Validation error when the host has no dot.

errorDomainInvalid.description: Validation error when the host starts or ends with a dot.

errorStartSession.description: Error shown in the popup; REASON is the reason reported by the extension.

errorExtension.description: Error shown in the popup when messaging the extension throws; REASON is the thrown message.

errorCreateTabs.description: Reason reported when Chrome did not return tab ids for the session tabs.

errorOpenReplayTab.description: Error on the replay page when the tab for the replay could not be opened.

activeSource.description: Heading in the running-session card above the source URL.

activeTargets.description: Heading in the running-session card above the list of target URLs.

pause.description: Button that pauses the running session or the replay.

resume.description: Button that resumes a paused session.

stop.description: Button that ends the session or the replay.

tileWindows.description: Button that puts the session windows side by side.

tileWindowsTitle.message: Source in one window, targets in another

downloadHeading.description: Label next to the JSON and Text download links.

downloadJson.description: Download link for the JSON export. Keep as is.

downloadText.description: Download link for the plain text export.

settingsNote.message: Saved automatically and applied to running sessions immediately.
settingsNote.description: Note at the top of the settings panel.

settingMirrorPasswordsHint.message: Off keeps credentials out of target tabs and exported logs

settingsOverlays.description: Settings section heading for the cursor and badge drawn on pages.

settingShowCursor.description: Toggle label. The ghost cursor is the virtual pointer drawn on target tabs.

settingShowCursorHint.message: The pointer drawn on target tabs
settingShowCursorHint.description: Hint under the ghost cursor toggle.

settingShowBadge.description: Toggle label. The badge is the floating SOURCE / TARGET label.

settingShowBadgeHint.message: The SOURCE / TARGET label on each tab
settingShowBadgeHint.description: Hint under the role badge toggle. Use the same words as badgeSource and badgeTarget.

settingMousemoveHint.message: Highest volume event, turn off to cut traffic
settingMousemoveHint.description: Hint under the mouse movement toggle.

settingKeystrokesHint.message: Key up / down, separate from typed input values

settingSmoothScrollHint.message: Off jumps instantly, keeps fast scrolls in sync
settingSmoothScrollHint.description: Hint under the smooth scrolling toggle.

settingScrollDebounce.description: Label of the number field for the scroll debounce in milliseconds.

settingScrollDebounceHint.message: Quiet period before a scroll is sent
settingScrollDebounceHint.description: Hint under the scroll debounce field.

unitMs.description: Unit shown after number fields: milliseconds.

settingTabDelay.description: Label of the number field for the delay between opening target tabs.

settingTabDelayHint.message: Delay between each target tab. 0 opens them all at once; useful for sites that rate-limit bursts.
settingTabDelayHint.description: Hint under the staggered tab opening field.

infoIntro.message: MirrorTab mirrors DOM interactions: clicks, inputs, keystrokes, focus, hover and scrolling, iframes included, from a Source tab to one or more Target tabs in real time. Perfect for demos, testing and live presentations.
infoIntro.description: Intro paragraph of the info panel. HTML: keep the <strong> tags.

infoStep1.message: Enter a Source URL and at least one Target URL.
infoStep1.description: Info panel step. HTML: keep the <strong> tags.

infoStep2.message: Click Start Session, the tabs open automatically.
infoStep2.description: Info panel step. HTML: keep the <strong> tags. Use the same words as startSession.

infoStep3.message: Interact with the SOURCE tab, actions mirror live to every TARGET tab.
infoStep3.description: Info panel step. HTML: keep both <strong> tags with their class attributes. Use the same words as badgeSource and badgeTarget.

infoStep4.message: Use Pause / Resume or Stop to control the session.
infoStep4.description: Info panel step. HTML: keep the <strong> tags. Use the same words as pause, resume and stop.

infoStep5.message: Download the event log as JSON or Text any time.
infoStep5.description: Info panel step. HTML: keep the <strong> tags.

infoReport.description: Link in the info panel that opens the issue templates.

infoCreatedBy.description: Label before the author link in the info panel.

reviewTitle.description: Heading of the popup card that asks for a Chrome Web Store review after the extension has been used for a while.

reviewText.message: A short review on the Chrome Web Store helps other developers find it.
reviewText.description: Body of the review card. Use the Chrome Web Store name Chrome shows in this language.

reviewRate.description: Review card button that opens the Chrome Web Store review page.

reviewLater.description: Tooltip and label of the close button on the review card; it hides the card and asks again after more use.

reviewNever.description: Review card button that hides the card for good.

replayLink.description: Link in the popup that opens the replay page.

footerEvents.message: Clicks · Inputs · Keystrokes · Focus · Hover · Scroll · Iframes
footerEvents.description: Popup footer listing what is mirrored. Must fit on one line of a 360px wide popup at a 10px font, so prefer short words. Keep the middle dots.

replayTitle.description: Browser tab title of the replay page.

replaySubtitle.description: Subtitle under the name in the replay page header.

replayStatusReady.description: Replay status pill before a replay starts.

replayStatusPlaying.description: Replay status pill while events are replayed.

replayStatusReloading.description: Replay status pill while the tab reloads for a restart.

replayStatusCompleted.description: Replay status pill when every event was replayed.

replayUrlLabel.description: Label of the URL field on the replay page.

replayUrlHint.message: The page where recorded actions will be replayed
replayUrlHint.description: Hint under the URL field on the replay page.

replayFileLabel.description: Label of the file field on the replay page.

replayDropHint.message: Drop a .json or .txt session file here
replayDropHint.description: Drop zone text. HTML: keep the <strong> tags and the file extensions.

replayOr.description: Word between the drop zone text and the browse button.

replayBrowse.description: Button that opens the file picker.

replayRemoveFile.description: Tooltip of the button that clears the chosen file.

replayOpening.description: Button text while the replay tab is being opened.

replayHeading.description: Heading above the URL in the running-replay card.

replayProgress.description: Progress text; CURRENT is the number of events already replayed, TOTAL the number of events in the file.

replayContinue.description: Button that resumes a paused replay.

replayRestart.description: Button that reloads the tab and replays from the beginning.

replayCompletedText_one.description: Completed card text for a count of one; COUNT is the number of events.

replayCompletedText_other.message: All $COUNT$ events have been replayed successfully.
replayCompletedText_other.description: Completed card text; COUNT is the number of events. Other plural forms may be added as replayCompletedText_few, replayCompletedText_many.

replayClose.description: Button on the completed card that ends the replay.

replayFileTypeError.description: Error for a file with another extension.

replayNoEvents.message: No events found in the session file
replayNoEvents.description: Error for a file that holds no events.

replayParseError.description: Error for a file that could not be read.

replayEventsLoaded_one.description: Text under the chosen file for a count of one; COUNT is the number of events.

replayEventsLoaded_other.description: Text under the chosen file; COUNT is the number of events. Other plural forms may be added as replayEventsLoaded_few, replayEventsLoaded_many.

replayUrlInvalid.description: Error under the URL field on the replay page.

replayFileMissing.description: Error when starting without a file.

replayNoResponse.description: Error when the extension did not answer.

pendingTitle.description: Browser tab title of the waiting page shown while a target tab waits for its turn.

pendingTitleFor.description: Browser tab title of the waiting page; URL is the page that will open.

pendingNote.message: Staggered start is on, so this tab opens after a short delay.
pendingNote.description: Note under the heading of the waiting page.

pendingOpening.description: Note on the waiting page once the countdown ended.

pendingHint.message: Change this under Staggered tab opening in the MirrorTab settings.
pendingHint.description: Small print on the waiting page. HTML: keep the <strong> tag with its class. Use the same words as settingTabDelay.

badgeSource.description: Floating badge on the tab whose interactions are captured. Upper case where the script has it.

badgeTarget.description: Floating badge on tabs that receive the mirrored interactions. Upper case where the script has it.

badgeReplay.description: Floating badge on the tab that replays a recorded session. Upper case where the script has it.
